title: Painting Manager - Polypaint
description: A full-stack workflow management platform developed for the Polyball Werkstatt at ETH Zürich. The application enables users to track the progress of painting projects and manage studio space allocation, while a dedicated admin section provides control over user groups and permissions.

title: Vall'doAido - Branding for a Local Business
description: Since 2023 I have been designing the brand touchpoints for [Vall'doAido](https://valldoaido.ch), a Portuguese wine merchant and online store in Switzerland: the store opening campaign, a printed wine catalogue, recurring seasonal tasting campaigns, packaging, signage and social media.

title: Skischool Event raffle - Web Application
description: A web application for managing raffles for skischool events and competitions built specifically for the [Skischool Mürren](https://skischule-muerren.ch).

title: Website for a Manual Therapist
description: A custom WordPress theme built from scratch for a manual therapy practice in Hägendorf, Switzerland. Features a two-axis content architecture for the blog (symptom area × content type), a self-built therapy finder, scroll-driven animations, and a fully custom LocalBusiness/FAQ schema for local SEO — no page builder, no build step required on the server.
